events.headline: HOW CLOSING THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ RAISES YOUR GROCERY BILL
events.detail: Closing the Strait of Hormuz raised oil prices. It also raises the cost of bread.

events.headline: DRONE STRIKE DISRUPTS DUBAI FLIGHTS AS IRAN CONTINUES GULF ATTACKS
events.detail: Iran has sought to justify its attacks on Gulf countries, hitting civilian infrastructure as well as US assets.

events.headline: JAPAN BEGINS RELEASE OF OIL RESERVES AS IRAN WAR SPARKS ENERGY CRISIS
events.detail: Tokyo's move comes as oil prices remain elevated amid the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: NOBODY WANTS TO GET INVOLVED’ IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ MILITARY OPERATIONS
events.detail: Charles Kupchan says the US and allies are reluctant to use military means to safeguard the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: OIL PRICES KEEP RISING AS TRUMP SEEKS COALITION TO REOPEN STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: Brent crude tops $106 a barrel as markets see no end in sight to the halt of traffic through the critical waterway.

events.headline: HOW PASSENGER PLANES KEEP FLYING DURING A WAR
events.detail: Airspace over Iran and the Gulf remains severely restricted following missile strikes, putting additional pressure on airlines.
